up: Retrieve the exact activity measurements and chemical structures for all compounds that were tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4649944. The output should include: standard_type (type of activity measurement, e.g., IC50, Ki, etc.), standard_relation (should be '=' for exact values), standard_value (numeric value), standard_units (units of measurement), molecule_chembl_id (ChEMBL compound identifier), and canonical_smiles (SMILES representation of the compound structure). Only include activities where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null, to ensure exact values. Include all activity types present. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649944' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
